title: Quick Stash
description: Stash your inventory into any container with one keypress, Terraria-style. Lock specific items so they never get swept away by accident.
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/okeocvDu7BU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe># Inventory Quick Transfer

Inventory Quick Transfer is a lightweight client-side mod that lets you quickly move items from your inventory into nearby containers with a single key press.

### Features

-  Quickly transfer items to:
  - Chests
  - Shulker Boxes
  - Barrels
  - Dispensers
  - Droppers
  - Hoppers
-  Lock specific inventory slots to prevent important items from being transferred.
-  Fully customizable keybinds for quick transfer and lock mode.
-  Lightweight and easy to use.

### How It Works

1. Open a supported container.
2. Press the configured transfer key.
3. All unlocked items that fit will be moved into the container.
4. Enable lock mode to mark slots that should always stay in your inventory.

### Compatibility

- Client-side mod.
- Works with Fabric.
- Supports Minecraft 1.21.10 and newer (depending on the released version).

### Notes

This mod only automates inventory management. It does not add any new items, blocks, or gameplay mechanics.
